    [kickoff] adopt MultiPref as the disagreement corpus; stats module + invariant tests
    
    Problem: HMDA supplies label multiplicity from a single annotator (the lender), not
    expert disagreement, leaving the paper exposed to HAIC's own theme. Needed a corpus
    with genuine per-annotator labels.
    
    Evidence: runs/h0/eval_multipref.json. allenai/multipref, n=10,461, exactly 4
    annotators per item split 2 expert / 2 normal on a 5-point ordinal scale.
    Contested 91.397% (5pt) and 78.922% (coarse A/T/B), mean normalized entropy 0.4964
    -> passes the pre-registered bar (>=5% contested, <=85% unanimous) by a wide margin.
    Expert-pair split 50.110%; expert-vs-normal majority divergence 49.804%, which makes
    "expert disagreement" measurable directly instead of by proxy.
    tests: 22 passed in 0.04s, including the unanimity invariant (every aggregator must
    equal majority vote when annotators agree) and the erasure-definition tests.
    
    Next: shared harness (batched local inference + judge wrapper), then H2 erasure.

h1_ranking_milestones.title: H1: team-configuration ranking reversal
h1_ranking_milestones.notes: PRE-REGISTERED KILL: Kendall tau > 0.9 between disagreement-aware and single-label rankings across all team configurations - report the null and stop. Baselines a reviewer will demand: majority vote, Dawid-Skene, and STABLEVAL (2605.02122) itself. Five team configs: agent-only, human-only, agent-proposes/human-reviews, human-proposes/agent-reviews, agent-with-abstention+escalation.
